title: Remediation SLA table
description: Schema for .claude/skills/regulatory-catalogs/references/sla-table.json, the single source of truth for finding remediation deadlines. Workflows look up (instrument, topic, severity) here to compute finding.slaDueAt and never invent SLA days. Human-curated, so provenance is optional

entries.basis: SEBI CSCRF 2024, PR.MA.S3: patches for high-severity vulnerabilities shall be applied within 1 week of release
SEBI CSCRF 2024, PR.MA.S3: high-severity vulnerabilities in critical systems shall be remediated within 1 week
CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022, para (ii): report cyber incidents within 6 hours of noticing or being brought to notice
DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 7: intimate the Data Protection Board within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach

lastReviewedAt.description: Date a human last checked every entry against the cited clauses; required because this table is the single source of truth for deadlines

precedence.description: How to resolve several matching entries. 'most-strict-wins' takes the shortest deadline across all applicable instruments. 'company-override' additionally lets company-profile sdlc/policy.json dependencyPolicy.vulnerabilitySlaDays (per severity) replace the days of patch-sla rows and of the defaults for that company; no other topic has an override field in sdlc-policy yet, so every other row is applied as written

defaults.description: Fallback remediation deadlines in days by severity, used only when no entry matches the finding's instruments and topic

entries.description: One row per (instrument, topic, severity) deadline stated or implied by a regulatory clause. Rows must be unique by that key; uniqueItems only rejects byte-identical rows, so the loader that reads the table must reject two rows sharing (instrument, topic, severity)

topic.description: Closed vocabulary of hard-requirement topics that carry a numeric obligation (deadline, cadence, retention, count). Shared by the instruments registry, finding.slaBasis and incident.regulatorReportRefs. 'other' is a last resort for a one-off clause: add a topic here before 'other' is used a second time

days.description: Deadline in whole calendar days from the moment the obligation starts (finding firstSeenAt, incident detectedAt)

instrument.description: Instrument whose clause sets this deadline

controlId.description: Control or clause id within the instrument that states the deadline, when the instrument numbers it

severity.description: Maxwell severity the row applies to, or 'any' when the clause does not distinguish severities

hours.description: Deadline in hours when the clause is stated in hours (6 for CERT-In, 72 for DPDP). days must then be the ceiling in calendar days

basis.description: The clause quoted or closely paraphrased, prefixed with the instrument name and clause number, so a reviewer can verify the number without opening the source

url.description: Deep link to the clause or the instrument text
